raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL), inf AS (SELECT i.* FROM provenance.v_infraction i JOIN current_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE i.is_current = true), lang AS (SELECT d.run_id,d.experiment,d.window_name,d.lead_s,BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_violation,MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms,BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric='itl') AS itl_violation,MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric='itl') AS itl_p99_ms FROM current_dim d JOIN inf i USING(run_id) WHERE d.pool='language' AND d.policy='reactive' GROUP BY d.run_id,d.experiment,d.window_name,d.lead_s), riders AS (SELECT d.run_id,c.provisioned_worker_seconds,MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric='ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms,BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) AS any_tail_violation FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost c USING(run_id) JOIN inf i USING(run_id) WHERE d.experiment='riders' AND d.pool='language' AND d.policy='reactive' GROUP BY d.run_id,c.provisioned_worker_seconds), enc AS (SELECT d.run_id,d.experiment,d.window_name,d.lead_s,i.achieved_p99_ms,i.is_violation FROM current_dim d JOIN inf i USING(run_id) WHERE d.pool='encoder' AND d.policy='reactive' AND i.sla_metric='encoder_delay') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lang) AS current_reactive_language_denominator,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lang WHERE ttft_violation) AS language_ttft_violations,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lang WHERE ttft_violation AND NOT itl_violation) AS language_ttft_fail_itl_pass,(SELECT MIN(ttft_p99_ms) FROM lang WHERE ttft_violation) AS language_violating_min_ttft_p99_ms,(SELECT MAX(ttft_p99_ms) FROM lang WHERE ttft_violation) AS language_violating_max_ttft_p99_ms,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('experiment',experiment,'window',window_name,'runs',runs,'ttft_violations',ttft_violations) ORDER BY experiment,window_name) FROM (SELECT experiment,window_name,COUNT(*) AS runs,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ttft_violation) AS ttft_violations FROM lang GROUP BY experiment,window_name) x) AS language_breakdown,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riders) AS spend_ladder_configs,(SELECT MIN(provisioned_worker_seconds) FROM riders) AS spend_min_worker_seconds,(SELECT MAX(provisioned_worker_seconds) FROM riders) AS spend_max_worker_seconds,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riders WHERE any_tail_violation) AS spend_ladder_tail_failures,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enc) AS current_reactive_encoder_denominator,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enc WHERE is_violation) AS encoder_violations,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('window',window_name,'runs',runs,'violations',violations) ORDER BY window_name) FROM (SELECT window_name,COUNT(*) AS runs,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation) AS violations FROM enc GROUP BY window_name) y) AS encoder_window_breakdown
raw.observed: Current unsuperseded denominator: 44 reactive language runs, 41 TTFT violations and 7 TTFT-fail/ITL-pass runs; all 4 spend-ladder configurations violate a tail bound; encoder has 12 violations among 34 runs, including 8 of 8 burst3 runs.
raw.claimed: 14 language configurations meet a window-mean law while violating tail SLA; spend cannot buy the tail back under lead; every encoder window with onset faster than lead loses.
raw.evidence: v_infraction verifies tail outcomes but contains neither window-mean-law nor onset-speed evidence; the finite 4-configuration spend ladder cannot establish the universal causal 'cannot' claim.
raw.fix: Replace with the directly supported scoped result: 41 of 44 current reactive language runs violate TTFT p99, all 4 tested spend-ladder configurations violate a tail bound, and all 8 tested burst3 encoder configurations violate encoder-delay p99; remove the mean-law, onset-speed, and universal causal wording unless separately backed.
